# SNORBIK Industrial AI Agent Factory Showcase

> Industrial platform for manufacturing secure, reusable AI agents with Clean Architecture, MCP (Model Context Protocol), ACP (Agent Client Protocol), and deterministic PDP governance.

## Key Capabilities
- Multi-stage AI Agent Factory: Discover, Reuse, Adapt, Assemble, Validate, Package.
- Hotel Concierge & Booking Agent V2 (`CTR-COMMON-OFFER-V2`, `PDP = ASK`, idempotent `BookingReceipt`).
- Geo Discovery & Travel Intelligence (`search_nearby_places`, `calculate_distance_and_route`, `build_itinerary`).
- Workstation V2 3-Column Cockpit: ACP/MCP discovery, Gemini ACP real-time tool execution, structured Workspace rendering, and session JSON artifact explorer.
- INV-07 Bipartite Pipeline Doctrine for MCP tool descriptions.
